text:
Samira H.: Postmortem follow-up for NovusEdge dedicated pool. Short recap: customer edge experienced transient route churn during nightly snapshots and our isolation service treated the churn as a confirmed split, causing a wide tenant isolation and ~3.8h degradation. Need owners, ETAs, and recurrence detection.

Samira H.: Proposed action items:
• Isolation service hotfix: debounce withdraws + origin-AS/prefix sanity checks — owner/ETA?
• Targeted peering hardening for NovusEdge (per-peer dampening, keepalive tweak only for that neighbor) — owner/ETA?
• Canary workflow for on-prem peering changes (synthetic /24 + canary tenant) — owner/ETA?
• Runbook updates & pre/post smoke tests — owner/ETA?
• Alerting: route-flap detector -> auto-ticket + page for high-risk customers — owner/ETA?

Alex D.: I can take peering hardening. Plan: add neighbor dampening for NovusEdge, keepalive bump to 30s for just that neighbor, and add prefix ACL. ETA: design + staging test in 7 days, rollout in 13.

Rae (sre): I'll build the canary harness and smoke checks. Suggest synthetic /24, canary tenant, 30m probe, validate KV cache and tail-latency. ETA: harness in 4 days.

Tom C.: I'll own the isolation service hotfix. Quick plan: 1) 20s debounce window for withdraw events, 2) require origin-AS match for 60s before isolation, 3) emit isolation_decision metrics with context, 4) add unit+integration tests. ETA: hotfix PR in 3 business days, canary in 8 days.

lia-csm: I'll coordinate NovusEdge maintenance window and pull BGP logs for validation. Can confirm slot by EOD tomorrow.

rdw-bot: Jira created: RDW-3120 (novus-peering-harden), RDW-3121 (isolation-service-debounce), RDW-3122 (novus-onprem-canary). Links: https://jira.redwood.example/browse/RDW-3120 , https://jira.redwood.example/browse/RDW-3121 , https://jira.redwood.example/browse/RDW-3122

Alex D.: Preflight check (staging):
```
# check BGP neighbor state on staging-edge
ssh ops@staging-edge 'vtysh -c "show ip bgp summary"'
```

Tom C.: Local test to simulate route churn:
```
# on test-router simulate transient withdraws
for i in 1 2 3; do ip route add 198.51.100.0/24 via 192.0.2.$i; sleep 12; ip route del 198.51.100.0/24; done
```

Rae (sre): Alert proposal: fire if >3 BGP resets for a peer within 12m OR >5 route changes for novus-prefixes in 15m -> auto-open RDW incident + tag novus. Add Grafana tile: "novus_peer_flaps_30d".

Samira H.: Prioritization: RDW-3121 (isolation hotfix) = prio:critical, RDW-3120 = prio:high, RDW-3122 = prio:medium. Hotfix blocks canary rollout.

rdw-bot: Calendar invite "NovusEdge peering remediation sync" created at 2312352000. Invitees: @Alex D., @Tom C., @Rae (sre), @lia-csm, @Samira H.

Alex D.: small note: avoid global hold-time changes; prefer per-neighbor dampening.

Tom C.: agreed. debounce + origin checks first, canary then policy changes.

Samira H.: Confirm owners & ETAs here by EOD. If blockers, call out now.

Alex D.: confirmed owner RDW-3120, ETA design+staging 7 days.

Tom C.: confirmed owner RDW-3121, ETA hotfix 3 business days.

Rae (sre): confirmed RDW-3122, ETA harness 4 days.

lia-csm: will lock maintenance window by tomorrow EOD and post logs to RDW-3122.

Samira H.: Thanks all. I will update the postmortem with owners, ETAs, and add a monthly peering-health check for NovusEdge. If anything changes, update the Jira ticket and ping this thread. :white_check_mark:
